verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Authenticator notifications can be mirrored to a wearable device, which implies some code/approval visibility without pulling out the phone, but there's no explicit confirmation that time-based OTP codes themselves are readable on a smartwatch screen, nor any hands-on/community corroboration of this specific wearable experience. missing for 10: explicit documentation that OTP codes (not just approval notifications) display on smartwatch, independent/hands-on confirmation of the wearable experience.
